title: Honest Confidence-Set Diameter for Causal Orientation in Equal-Variance Gaussian Models
banked_reason: BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: math review PASS, but general review assesses subfield at 7.3 below the 7.4 field floor and NOT salvageable in scope; the remaining comparator-table mismatch is mechanical and cannot bridge the gap.
gap_reasons: The delivered headline is an exact nuisance-uniform minimax expected-diameter frontier with a matching binary converse and explicit honest construction, but it applies only to the known-zero-mean, bounded bivariate equal-error Gaussian union; larger classes receive only converse transfer.

The separation theorem leaves the exact critical boundary unresolved, so it does not complete that distinct phase diagram, although the prose consistently discloses this and does not overstate the proved radius frontier.
The forest result establishes root-n inference only for a fixed-dimensional known skeleton with one weak internal path edge, while the first-edge branch classification remains open.
The comparisons with published likelihood procedures provide no common triangular-array calibration or regret calculation, leaving the practical inferential advantage unquantified.

Unrepaired mechanical panel finding: comparator_table_mismatch@thm:sharp-diameter-envelope-answer — position Strieder--Freidling--Haffner--Drton (2021) Theorem 1 as informed-by rather than unmatched/dropped_from_abstract; the validity gate found that this cannot bridge the 7.3-to-7.4 novelty gap.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived a complete radius-uniform sharp honest-diameter frontier and explicit attaining construction for the bounded centered bivariate equal-error Gaussian union, together with the no-log separation transition away from its critical boundary, a converse-only transfer to larger classes, and a root-n internal weak-edge forest result. The mathematical referee passed the package with no findings, but the general referee capped it at subfield because exact attainment remained bivariate, comparator regret was not delivered, and the critical-boundary and first-edge branch frontiers remained open. A validity-gate audit confirmed that the sole comparator-table mismatch was mechanical and that resolving any remaining OEQ would require a genuinely new experiment rather than a bounded repair.
tldr: For the bounded known-zero-mean bivariate equal-error Gaussian union with compact nuisance scale, the complete uniformly honest diameter frontier is \(n^{1/4}R_n(r)=K_\alpha(n^{1/4}r)+o(1)\) uniformly over \(0\leq r\leq B\), where \(K_\alpha(c)=\max_{0\leq h\leq c}h[\Phi(z_{1-\alpha}-h^2)-\alpha]_+\) and \(K_\alpha(0)=0\). An explicit Wishart-pilot and worst-quantile pivot attains the entire frontier uniformly over signs, orientations, and nuisance scales. The matched Daskalakis--Kandiros--Yao covariance pair transfers the local and global lower bounds, but not equality or the upper construction, to larger classes containing an experiment-preserving embedding. The paper also proves the no-log transition to root-\(n\) inference away from the critical boundary and root-\(n\) regularity for an internal weak edge on an explicit bounded known-forest subclass. Exactly three questions remain open: the critical-boundary constant, procedure-specific likelihood regret, and the full first-edge weak-branch classification.
gap: Equal-error work establishes population identification, the singular bivariate confidence problem, valid test inversion, and fourth-root graph-recovery hardness, but not the nuisance-uniform minimax expected diameter of an honest causal-effect set at the collision. Wang--Kolar--Drton construct asymptotic confidence sets for causal orderings and post-process them into effect intervals under independent-error additive-noise assumptions, but do not analyze this Gaussian equal-error fourth-root experiment or minimax full-set diameter. Existing polytree work also does not determine when a particular target effect is regular without exact recovery of its weak orientation.
fill: First determine whether the exact Wishart-pilot and worst-quantile pivot construction is measurable, finite-sample honest, and attains the binary candidate at all mandatory nuisance checkpoints; then prove the candidate sharp envelope or derive the larger forced envelope, establish the separated-class phase diagram, audit likelihood-region regret under the same triangular-array criterion, and prove the internal-edge theorem over the same explicit bounded subclass in both coverage and risk without extrapolating it to first-edge branch configurations.
